people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals.”
translations.bsb: Otherwise, when my lord the king rests with his fathers, I and my son Solomon will be counted as criminals.”
translations.kjv: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
translations.asv: Otherwise it will come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
